What major world change follows the first defeat of the Wall of Flesh?
The world permanently enters Hardmode. Stronger enemies and new progression content become available, and the Hallow plus the world's evil biome are generated and begin spreading more aggressively.

Bring the Copper Watering Can, five Iron Bars, and 5,000g to Clint at the Blacksmith.

How do I build and activate the smallest standard Nether portal?
Build an obsidian frame with a 2-by-3 interior opening. The four corner blocks may be omitted, so the smallest frame uses ten obsidian. Use flint and steel inside the frame to activate it.
